invite.description: Share the link with whoever you want.

install.title: Install OpenCall
install.description: Install OpenCall as an app — it opens straight up, without the browser bar.
install.descriptionIos: Add OpenCall to your home screen to open it like an app, no browser needed.
install.iosStep1: Tap the ••• in the Safari bar
install.iosStep3: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen
install.afterInstall: Once installed, this notice won't show up again.
install.afterInstallIos: Once it's on your home screen, this notice won't show up again.

moderation.description: The nickname and picture this person chose. Removing them brings back what comes from Discord.
moderation.hiddenNicknameNotice: The nickname below is saved but not visible: this person chose to be seen by their Discord name. The picture, if there is one, still applies.
moderation.emptyReturnsDiscord: Leaving it empty brings back the Discord name.
moderation.noCustomPhoto: No custom picture — already using the Discord one.

call.powerSavingHint: The call is still live. Tap to wake the screen back up!

channel.title: Something went wrong in this channel.
channel.description: The room's audio isn't affected. Try reloading this area — if it keeps happening, let us know.

update.title: Update available
update.description: OpenCall got an update while you were here.
update.callToAction: Reload the page to pick up the latest version.

profile.heading: Profile
profile.description: A nickname and a picture that are just yours, layered over what comes from Discord. They apply across OpenCall.
profile.photoHint: PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP or AVIF, up to 10 MB. GIFs stay animated, cropped from the center.
profile.nicknameHint: Leave it empty to use your Discord name ({username}).

errors.UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE: Format not accepted. Use PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP or AVIF.
errors.INVALID_IMAGE_BYTES: That file isn't a valid image.
errors.ANIMATION_TOO_HEAVY: That GIF gets too heavy once cropped. Try one with fewer frames.
errors.INVALID_NICKNAME: The nickname needs to be between 2 and {max} characters.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Easy there — wait a moment before trying again.

discordOn.title: Using your Discord profile
discordOn.description: You show up as {username}, with the picture from there. {saved, select, both {Your nickname and your picture stay} name {Your nickname stays} avatar {Your picture stays} other {What was yours stays}} saved here.

maskOn.title: Mask on
maskOn.avatarOnly: Your picture is back in effect.

photoUpdated.title: Photo updated
photoUpdated.description: It's already the one everyone sees.

photoRemoved.title: Photo removed
photoRemoved.description: Your Discord picture is back in effect.

animatedImage.title: Animated image
animatedImage.description: GIFs are cropped from the center, no manual framing.

accountLink.heading: Link & devices
accountLink.description: Sign in to the same account on another device by scanning a QR code, or typing the code there. No need for Discord again.

audioVideo.heading: Audio & video
audioVideo.description: Pick your devices and set how loud you have to be before your mic opens up.
audioVideo.micSensitivityHint: Below the threshold the mic stays silent. Drag right if people say you cut out; left if background noise gets through.

language.heading: Language
language.description: Applies to this device only — the same login can stay in another language on your phone.
language.label: Interface language

auth.welcomeSubtitle: Sign in to get the full experience.
auth.signInDescription: Your Discord account unlocks the voice channels and the chat.
auth.hintMobile: Already signed in on your computer? Open Sign in on another device over there and scan it here — nothing to type.
auth.hintDesktop: Already signed in on another device? Open Sign in on another device over there and type it here — no password needed.

qrStep.title: Scan the QR code
qrStep.description: On the device you're already signed in on, open Sign in on another device and point the camera at the QR code.

codeStep.title: Access code
codeStep.description: On the device you're already signed in on, open Sign in on another device and type the six characters shown there.
codeStep.invalid: Invalid or expired code. Generate a new one on the device you're signed in on — each code lasts 2 minutes.
codeStep.blocked: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes or sign in with Discord.

authenticated.title: Account authenticated
authenticated.description: Taking you to the full experience…

camera.denied: No camera access. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
camera.unsupported: This browser doesn't give access to the camera.

scanner.title: Scan the QR code
scanner.description: On the device you're already signed in on click the Sign in on another device button to generate the access code, then scan it!

pairing.title: Sign in on another device
pairing.description: Scan it with the camera or type the code to sign in without entering your Discord password again.

qrPage.expiredTitle: This code expired or was already used.
qrPage.expiredDescription: Generate a new QR code on the other device and scan it again.

noAccess.almostThereSubtitle: An invite code unlocks the channels for you.
noAccess.title: Invite code
noAccess.description: Your account doesn't have channel access yet. Paste the code an admin gave you here, or ask them to grant it in /admin/channels.
noAccess.blocked: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again.

composer.blocked: An admin blocked you from sending messages
composer.clearCommandDescription: Deletes the last N messages in the channel

list.empty: No messages here yet. Send the first one!

chat.typing: {count, plural, =1 {{first} is typing…} =2 {{first} and {second} are typing…} other {{first} and {others} others are typing…}}

view.deleteDescription: This can't be undone. The message disappears for everyone in the channel.
view.deleteFailedNetwork: Check your connection and try again.
view.cleared: {count, plural, =1 {The last message was deleted} other {The last # messages were deleted}}

users.title: Users
users.description: Channel admins manage who has access to OpenCall; combined with platform admin, that makes a superadmin.
users.selfTooltip: You can't change this for yourself here
users.adminOnlyChannelsTooltip: Only an admin can remove channel admin from another admin
users.adminOnlyAccessTooltip: Only an admin can change OpenCall access

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Create, edit and delete voice and text channels.

delete.title: Delete channel permanently
delete.body: This will permanently delete the channel <name>{channelName}</name>{messages, plural, =0 {} one { and <count>{messages}</count> message} other { and <count>{messages}</count> messages}}.
delete.voiceNote: Anyone already connected to the room stays connected, but nobody else will be able to join.

invites.title: Invites
invites.description: Multi-use codes that never expire — whoever pastes one gets access to the channels.
invites.redeemedCount: {count, plural, one {1 person joined with this code} other {# people joined with this code}}

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Manage the groups shown in the users sidebar.

form.sortHint: The lower the number, the higher the group appears.

stream.title: Streaming
stream.description: Quality of screen streams. Applies to every channel.
stream.underfed: {height}p at {fps} fps with {kbps} kbps will pixelate on motion — the encoder can't spend bitrate the ceiling doesn't allow.
stream.underfedOverCeiling: This combination needs ~{min} kbps and doesn't fit under the {ceiling} kbps ceiling: lower the resolution or the fps.
stream.underfedUseAtLeast: For this combination, use at least {min} kbps.
stream.congestionDescription: What to sacrifice when the streamer's bandwidth can't keep up.
stream.savedDescription: Streams in progress already changed; anyone opening now starts on the new config.

economico.label: 540p economical
economico.hint: Lowest server bandwidth. Readable, but loses detail on motion.

equilibrado.label: 720p balanced
equilibrado.hint: Good picture for gameplay at half the egress of 1080p.

fluido.label: 720p smooth
fluido.hint: Smoother motion at the same resolution, for ~60% more bandwidth than 720p30.

alta.label: 1080p high
alta.hint: LiveKit's official 1080p30 preset. Highest bandwidth cost.

maintain-framerate.label: Smoothness
maintain-framerate.hint: Under congestion, blurs the picture instead of stuttering. Right for gameplay.

maintain-resolution.label: Sharpness
maintain-resolution.hint: Under congestion, drops frames to keep the detail. Right for code and spreadsheets.

infra.title: Infra
infra.description: LiveKit VPS usage and cost forecast.
infra.refreshFailedDescription: Failed to collect data from the VPS over SSH right now. Try again in a moment.

forecast.title: Cost forecast
forecast.unavailable: No plan data yet — as soon as the collector runs on the VPS for the first time, the forecast shows up here.
forecast.projection: Projected month end: ~{projected}GB ({days} days left, based on the average of recent days)
forecast.healthy: Usage within expectations — no sign an upgrade is needed.

infra.noData: No data yet — the VPS collector hasn't sent anything for this period.
